title: Akhil knows what his mother Manisha watched, read and did while he was elsewhere

tellings.quote: just sending information I could be watching a movie upstairs and he could be or downstairs and he could be in a whole another room of the house you know playing on his iPad can't hear anything and I could come back up and he'll tell me exactly what happened in this movie

plain: A boy named Akhil can say exactly what happened in a movie his mother Manisha watched while he was in another room and couldn't hear it, according to his mother. Ky Dickens, the filmmaker behind The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary about children said to read minds, passes on Manisha's words to Michels: "I could come back up and he'll tell me exactly what happened in this movie." If true, it would mean Akhil picks up his mother's experience by telepathy.
